meta.title: Add Missing Function Declaration: Does Not Correctly Declare Generic Function
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#49727 (Account for type parameters in missing function codefix), ebd42abf95, 2022-07-26; git tag --contains: first in v4.8-rc / v4.8.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.7.4 (2022-06-17) and typescript@4.8.2 (2022-08-25), both behind typescript-language-server@1.1.2 (the latest wrapper release before 4.8.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: The generated declaration 'function runEvilSideEffect(self: T)' uses the caller's type parameter T out of scope (TS2304 Cannot find name 'T').

settings_note: The issue names no settings (playground defaults); no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.note: the comment lines are part of the issue's code

repro.steps: Open index.ts: 'runEvilSideEffect(self)' reports TS2304 (cannot find name). Apply Quick Fix > Add missing function declaration. Reported: the generated 'function runEvilSideEffect(self: T)' is invalid (T is not in scope); expected a generic declaration 'function runEvilSideEffect<T>(self: T)'. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted TS2304 nor a new error.
